text: Night shift again. Eyes feel like sandpaper. Going straight to bed.
Baby up every two hours. I made coffee and forgot to drink it. Twice.
Long day, nothing terrible happened, I'm just wiped out.
Drove eight hours to Mum's. Back hurts, brain is mush. Ate toast and went to sleep at 8.
Jet lag. Wide awake at 3am, falling asleep in my soup at lunch.
Exhausted after moving all the furniture with Bartek. Every muscle complaining.
So sleepy. Couldn't focus on anything after lunch.
Three exams in two days. Done. I want to sleep for a week.
Low energy all week. Probably the cold I can't shake.
Wedding was beautiful but I danced until 2am and now I'm a husk.
Covering for two people at work this week. Getting home at nine. Barely talking to Sami.
Didn't sleep. Thunderstorm, dog panicking, then the alarm.
Chemo week. Body heavy. Sleeping on the sofa most of the day. Lily brought me broth.
Not sad, not stressed, just bone tired.
Finished the marathon. Legs gone. Lying on the floor with a bag of frozen peas on each knee.
Kids are back at school, I'm back at work, the routine is brutal. Asleep on the couch by 9.
Spent all day in the hospital waiting room with Dad. Didn't do anything and I'm exhausted.
Brain fog today. Read the same email five times.
Harvest season. Up at four every day, home at dark. Too tired to even shower properly.
Social battery completely drained after the conference. Three days of small talk. Need a quiet weekend.
Teething. Hers, not mine. Though at this point I'd believe either.
Yawning all through the meeting. Felix noticed and kindly pretended not to.
Flat-out day of cleaning before the in-laws arrive. Floors gleaming, me collapsing.
Tired in a way sleep doesn't fix. Months of this now.
Ran the 6am bootcamp, then a full day at the office, then Tomasz's birthday drinks. Done for.
Too tired to write much. Good day though.
Overnight flight with a crying baby two rows back. Landed and went straight to work. Zombie mode.
Ramadan fasting plus long workdays. Feeling slow and sleepy in the afternoons but okay.
Insomnia again. Watched the ceiling until 5. Got up at 7. Everything feels far away.
Hiking 22km with Wren and Jody. Gorgeous views. Feet destroyed. Will sleep like a log.
Caring for Grandma all weekend while Mum rested. I don't know how she does it every day.
End of term. Marked ninety essays. My eyes have stopped working.
Bit sleepy, bit sluggish. Lazy Sunday vibes.
Iron levels are low, doctor says. Explains the constant fatigue. Starting supplements.
Newborn week two. I've forgotten what day it is. Matteo keeps bringing me snacks and water like I'm a houseplant.
Pulled an all-nighter for the deadline. Shipped it. Now I can barely string a sentence together.
Heavy legs, heavy head. Went for a walk hoping it'd help. It didn't.
Moving house is the most tiring thing in the world. Packed 30 boxes. Thirty more to go.
Long shift at the restaurant. Feet aching, smelling of fryer oil, counting tips on the bus home.
Sleepless night worrying about Shira. Dragging myself through the day.
I'm fine, just knackered. Busy month.
Ward was understaffed. Twelve hours without a proper break. Came home and lay on the kitchen floor for a bit.
Exhausted from holding it together for everyone at the funeral. Now that they've gone I can barely stand.
Toddler refused to nap, so I didn't either. Running on fumes.
Weekend of gigs with the band. Loved it. Voice is gone, body is gone.
Too many late nights. My eyes are twitching. Bed by ten tonight, I swear.
Long recovery day after the operation. Walked to the bathroom and back and needed a nap.
Can't keep my eyes open. Reading the same page of the book over and over.
Juggling the two jobs is taking it out of me. Jiho said I look grey. He's not wrong.
Woke up tired, stayed tired, going to bed tired.
Spent the day helping Ngozi move. Four flights of stairs, no lift. My arms might fall off.
Dragged myself through the gym session. Zero energy. Probably should have rested.
Two kids with the flu, me with the flu, nobody sleeping. Survival mode.
Long day of meetings. Talked so much my face hurts. Brain is empty.
The festival was amazing and I am now seventy years old.
Late flight, delayed baggage, taxi queue. Got home at 3am and slept in my clothes.
Feeling drained since the argument with Rafa yesterday. Not angry anymore. Just flat and tired.
Post-exam crash. Slept 12 hours and still woke up groggy.
Painted the whole hallway. Ceiling too. Neck is killing me and I'm ready to drop.
Weary today. Body and mind both asking for a break I can't give them yet.
Night feeds, early meetings, repeat. Losing track of the days.
Bit tired after the swim but in a nice way. Early night.
Long walk home in the snow because the buses stopped. Thawing by the radiator now, barely awake.
Up all night with the sick dog. Bram and I took turns. He's better now. We're not.
Lethargic. Did nothing all day. Even nothing felt like effort.
Inventory week at the shop. Counting the same screws for the third day.
Exhausted from the long-distance call schedule. Talking to Adaeze at midnight, working at eight.
Third wedding this month. Lovely couples. My wallet and feet are begging for mercy.
Sleep debt catching up with me. Dozed off on the train and missed my stop.
Long, heavy week. I'm going to sit in the bath until I turn into a prune.
